Class Game

java.lang.Object
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGame
public class Game extends Object implements IGame
Controls a single player's side of a Battleship match: it holds that player's IFleet, records every shot fired at it, and keeps running statistics about invalid shots, repeated shots, hits and sunk ships.

  • Method Details

    • fire

      public IShip fire(IPosition pos)
      Fires a shot at the given position and updates this game's statistics accordingly.

      The outcome depends on the position:

      • if pos is outside the board, it counts as an invalid shot and nothing else happens;
      • if pos has already been shot before, it counts as a repeated shot and nothing else happens;
      • otherwise the shot is recorded and, if it hits a ship, the hit count is increased and the ship is told it was shot; if that hit causes the ship to sink, the sink count is also increased and the sunk ship is returned.
      Specified by:
      fire in interface IGame
      Parameters:
      pos - the position being targeted
      Returns:
      the ship that was sunk by this shot, or null if no ship was sunk (whether because the shot missed, was invalid, was repeated, or only damaged a ship without sinking it)
